personas.name: Leon
goals: Submit queries without thinking about which model to use.
Understand why a query was routed to a specific backend.
Override routing quickly when testing a specific model.
painPoints: Manually switching between tools for different query types.
No visibility into which model handled a request or how long it took.
personas.description: developer who wants to Submit queries without thinking about which model to use., Understand why a query was routed to a specific backend., Override routing quickly when testing a specific model. and is frustrated by Manually switching between tools for different query types., No visibility into which model handled a request or how long it took., Configuration scattered across multiple tools..

userJourneys.name: Submit first query
userJourneys.startingState: Gateway is running. Developer has an OpenAI-compatible client configured to point at the gateway.

steps.action: Sends a query via their existing client tool.
Classifies the query and routes to the best available backend.
Receives response in their client tool with no visible difference from direct backend use.

userJourneys.desiredOutcome: Developer receives a response without having selected a backend manually.
userJourneys.description: End-to-end workflow: Gateway is running. Developer has an OpenAI-compatible client configured to point at the gateway.. Desired outcome: Developer receives a response without having selected a backend manually..

userJourneys.name: Inspect routing history
userJourneys.startingState: Several queries have been processed. Developer wants to understand routing decisions.

steps.action: Displays a table of recent queries with backend, latency, and status.
Filters the log by backend or time range.

userJourneys.desiredOutcome: Developer can see exactly which backend handled each query and how long it took.
userJourneys.description: End-to-end workflow: Several queries have been processed. Developer wants to understand routing decisions.. Desired outcome: Developer can see exactly which backend handled each query and how long it took..

userJourneys.name: Force a specific backend
userJourneys.startingState: Developer wants to test a specific backend directly.

steps.action: Passes a backend override flag in their query.
Bypasses classification and routes directly to the specified backend.
Returns response and logs the override.

userJourneys.desiredOutcome: Query is handled by the specified backend without changing global configuration.
userJourneys.description: End-to-end workflow: Developer wants to test a specific backend directly.. Desired outcome: Query is handled by the specified backend without changing global configuration..

userJourneys.name: Configure backends
userJourneys.startingState: Developer wants to add or reprioritise backends.

steps.action: Edits the configuration file in their editor.
Detects configuration file change and reloads without restart.
Confirms reload via a log message.

userJourneys.desiredOutcome: New backend configuration is active without restarting the gateway.
userJourneys.description: End-to-end workflow: Developer wants to add or reprioritise backends.. Desired outcome: New backend configuration is active without restarting the gateway..

states.name: healthy

states.name: degraded
states.description: Some backends are offline. Offline backends shown with ○ indicator and muted text.

states.name: no-backends
states.description: All backends are offline or unconfigured. Warning message shown. Query processing suspended.

interactionPatterns.name: Command Output
interactionPatterns.description: A command runs, prints its output to stdout, and exits with code 0 on success or non-zero on failure. Output is human-readable by default and machine-parseable with --json flag.

interactionPatterns.name: Watch Mode
interactionPatterns.description: A command runs continuously, refreshing its output in-place at a fixed interval. Interrupted by Ctrl+C. Exit code 0 on clean interrupt.

interactionPatterns.name: Pagination
interactionPatterns.description: Long output is split into pages. User navigates with keyboard. Current page and total shown in footer.

interactionPatterns.name: Keyboard Navigation
interactionPatterns.description: All interactive views are fully operable without a mouse. Every action has a keyboard binding.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Identifies the view and shows contextual metadata such as version or file path.
components.usageNotes: First line of every view. Bold text. No decoration.

components.name: StatusTable
components.purpose: Shows a list of named entities with a status indicator, label, and metadata columns.
components.usageNotes: Use ● for available, ○ for offline. Align columns with fixed-width spacing.

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: Shows tabular data with named columns and paginated rows.
components.usageNotes: Column headers bold. Alternating row dimming optional. Truncate long values with ellipsis.

components.name: FilterBar
components.purpose: Shows the currently active filter above a table.
components.usageNotes: Only visible when a filter is active. Format: 'Filter: <key>=<value>'.

components.name: OrderedList
components.purpose: Shows items with explicit numeric priority.
components.usageNotes: Two-space indent. Number followed by dot and name.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Shows summary counts, navigation hints, or keyboard shortcuts at the bottom of a view.
components.usageNotes: Dimmed text. Separated from body by a blank line.
